title: Preserve meaningful graphic content inside the final panel
rule: A meaningful text or data graphic must fit the rendered panel with its necessary labels visible, and decorative headlines must not cover its content.
action: Use contain or a purpose-made panel derivative for data/list graphics; remove competing overlay text and inspect the actual rendered frame beside its narration clause.
rationale: Two r03 frames used correct original sources but lost comparison labels through cover crop or checklist text through headline overlap.
applies_to: text and data graphics inside photo/gallery explainers
